title: Multiply Strings
summary: Multiply two nonnegative integers given as decimal strings.

contractDetails.constraints: Each string has 1–200 decimal digits and no leading zero unless it is exactly 0.

statement: Multiply two nonnegative integers given as decimal strings. Return the product as a decimal string. Work with digits without converting either entire input to a built-in integer or big integer.

examples.explanation: Zero times any input is zero.
The product keeps its trailing zeros.

constraints: Each string has 1–200 decimal digits and no leading zero unless it is exactly 0.
hints: Conceptual: Every pair of input digits contributes to a known place in the product.
Directional: The result needs at most the sum of the input lengths in digits.
Implementation: Accumulate the digit products, propagate carries, and skip leading zeros except for the single zero result.
